newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's JSE working on failed trading system.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's JSE working on failed trading system.

text.p: Johannesburg Stock Exchange president Roy Andersen said the exchange was working on the electronic Johannesburg Equity Trading system which failed on Friday morning.
He could not say when the system would be reactivated.
"The system is temporarily down while we solve a network problem," Andersen told Reuters.
The system malfunctioned at the 0730 GMT opening before being restored shortly afterwards, but failed again at around 0800 GMT, dealers said.
